en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town nestled among forested hills and farmland. In the foreground there is a sloping harvested field leading down to several simple, plastered houses with steep gabled roofs and small chimneys. Further back, more elaborate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century villas and town buildings appear among dense trees; one large villa stands prominently on a hillside, and another cluster of larger houses or small hotels lies to the right. The background shows rolling hills covered with woods and patchwork fields. The image edges are irregular, as if from an old photographic print used on a postcard. No printed caption or legible writing is visible on the image.
